rows.text: As more planets joined the pan-cosmic market, the IPC urgently needed a miniaturized hyper-distant delivery device for employees stationed in frontier regions. Eventually, the School of Pure Creation's "Interstellar Roaming Pager" won the bid. This device inherited the virtues of the Amber Lord: sturdy enough to serve as a noodle-cup weight, can opener, and emergency survival hammer all in one. Its signal was equally tenacious, maintaining a connection anywhere in the cosmos, even from within a black hole. Once deployed, frontier planets promptly saw a significant drop in absenteeism rates.
